oracle: Unmodified original ggml-quants.c scalar reference functions independently compiled into encoder_oracle.dll outside the Rust product; no Rust-derived expected bytes.
integer_note: The snapshot has no integer row quantizer. These expected values use the original ggml_set_f32_1d I8/I16/I32 C assignments and cover only finite, representable truncated values; Rust exposes a separate checked conversion API. I64 F32 assignment is absent in the source.
limits: Undefined C float-to-integer domains and non-finite packed-quantizer inputs are deliberately excluded from oracle fixtures and covered by Rust rejection tests. FP4 large finite saturation is included; half-scale quantizers use finite representable cases.
